title: Stabilizing the aluminum metal anode through polymer coating-enabled regulation of exchange current
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1477-1488
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03542A, Paper
Sichen Gu, Wanli Nie, Qiao Meng, Xinming Chen, Jiameng Zhang, Yun Cao, Wei Lv
A strategy to stabilize the aluminum metal anode by achieving a delicate balance between mitigating interphase reactions and ensuring efficient mass transport is proposed and realized through a finely tuned PDMS coating.
